content:
We have list of templates. Need the one that when applied to target reproduces sulfonamide formation. The mapped_rxn field is the forward reaction? It seems mapped_rxn includes reactants and product. For template 332897, mapped_rxn: 'CC1=CC=C(S(=O)(=O)[N:8]2[C:5]3=[C:4]([CH:3]=[C:2]([CH3:1])[CH:7]=[CH:6]3)[O:12][S:9]2(=[O:10])=[O:11])C=C1.O=S(=O)(Cl)Cl.CC1=CC=C(S(=O)(=O)NC2=C(O)C=C(C)C=C2)C=C1.CCN(CC)CC.ClCCl>>[CH3:1][C:2]1=[CH:3][C:4]2=[C:5]([CH:6]=[CH:7]1)[NH:8][S:9](=[O:10])(=[O:11])[O:12]2'

That seems to have product sulfonamide (NH-SO2-O?). The product SMILES: '[CH3:1][c:2]1[cH:3][c:4]2[c:5]([cH:6][cH:7]1)[NH:8][S:9](=[O:10])(=[O:11])[O:12]2' which is a sulfonamide attached to aromatic ring.

Our target likely similar. The precursors list from previous step: ['CC(=O)C=Cc1ccccc1', 'OCl'] which are not matching this template's reactants. So maybe another template.

Look at other entries: template 437773 has mapped_rxn: 'CC1=C(N=[N+]=[N-])C=C(C(=O)O)C=C1...>>[CH3:1][O:2][C:3]1=[C:4]([NH:5][C:6](=[O:7])[c:8]2... )' product is sulfonamide? It has [NH][C](=O) attached to aromatic, not sulfonamide.

Template 1253352: mapped_rxn product is '[CH2:1]=[CH:2][c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][c:7]([NH:8][c:9]2... )' not sulfonamide.

Template 332897 seems best: product contains sulfonamide (NH-SO2-O). The reactants include O=S(=O)(Cl)Cl which is sulfonyl chloride (ClSO2Cl). Also includes aromatic sulfonamide? Actually reactants include 'CC1=CC=C(S(=O)(=O)[N:8]2[C:5]3=... )C=C1' which is a sulfonamide already? Hard.

But our precursors are amine (CC(=O)C=Cc1ccccc1) which is not present. So maybe another template not in list due to criteria. Could search with functional_groups_formed = ["sulfonamides"] and broken maybe "primary amines" etc. Let's try search with functional_groups_formed ["sulfonamides"].
